risks.title: Increased Competition
risks.score_rationale: The company operates in a competitive market with numerous players, which could lead to pricing pressure and margin compression.

risks.title: Regulatory Risks
risks.score_rationale: The company is subject to government regulations and safety standards, which could result in increased costs and operational losses in case of non-compliance.

risks.title: Workforce Dependency
risks.score_rationale: The company relies heavily on its workforce to deliver services, which could lead to operational disruptions and higher costs in case of labor shortages.

risks.title: Supply Chain Risks
risks.score_rationale: The company depends on suppliers for raw materials and products necessary for its operations, which could lead to operational disruptions and increased costs in case of supply chain interruptions.

risks.title: Financial Risks
risks.score_rationale: The company has debt and financial obligations, which could lead to increased costs and operational losses in case of financial difficulties.

risks.title: Reputation Risks
risks.score_rationale: The company is sensitive to reputation and customer trust, which could lead to operational losses and increased costs in case of a reputational crisis.

risks.title: Cybersecurity Risks
risks.score_rationale: The company is exposed to cybersecurity risks, which could lead to operational losses and increased costs in case of a security breach.
